text:
maya: Heads-up — last canary promote for nf4-int4 -> prod-chat-v2 created a weird oscillation when we jumped 5% -> 25%. regen_count doubled for a few slices and P95 spiked 1100ms -> 1500ms.
kevin: Can you paste the slice and logs? link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod-chat-v2/canary/2333333000
maya: quick metrics snapshot:
```
slice: user_segment=mobile_nightly, samples=1200
before: regen_rate=2.8%, p95=1100ms
after: regen_rate=5.9%, p95=1500ms
quality_delta(semantic_eval)= -1.8% (worse)
```
sophie: that's the classic "sinker" — when traffic jump exposes tail-case decoding instability. we should tighten step sizes + add surge protection.
ryan: propose policy change: steps [5,10,20] (no 25), hold 30m, add sinker_protection window 10m watching regen_rate and p95. auto-fallback if regen + semantic drop.
elaine: concrete thresholds? i'd say auto-rollback if regen_rate increases by >15% OR semantic_quality drops >2% vs baseline over 10m window. also add alerting to #incidents if p95 > 1400ms for 5m.
maya: agreed. here's a draft rollout config to add to the canary controller:
```
{
  "policy": "staggered",
  "steps": [5,10,20],
  "hold_minutes": 30,
  "sinker_protection": {
    "window_minutes": 10,
    "regen_rate_pct_increase_threshold": 12,
    "p95_latency_ms_increase": 200
  },
  "auto_fallback": {
    "enabled": true,
    "checks": ["regen_rate","semantic_eval"],
    "regen_delta_pct": 15,
    "semantic_quality_drop_pct": 2
  }
}
```
kevin: can we also shadow-promote 10% traffic to int8 variant in parallel to compare latency/cost vs quality during this hold? shadow compare might help isolate quantization regressions.
ryan: yes — run quiet-burn at 10% for 1h and feed diffs to eval infra. add tag: "sinker-watch-2333333000"
maya: i'll schedule the shadow run and update the rollout policy in staging. if the auto-fallback fires, controller should immediately revert to previous model and notify #eng-oncall + #product.
elaine: i'll update the alert runbook with thresholds and rollback steps. suggest adding a small hysteresis (2 consecutive windows) to avoid flapping.
deploy-bot: canary promote initiated by maya at 2333333000: nf4-int4 -> prod-chat-v2 (5% -> 25%).
maya: thanks — will post a short postmortem if we need to rollback. :thumbsup:
kevin: ack. tagging @sophie for eval thresholds and @elaine for oncall updates.
sophie: on it, will run a few targeted prompt sets to stress regen logic and share results in this thread.
ryan: good plan. if we still see oscillation after smaller steps, we should consider prefix-cache warmup + longer KV retention for that slice.
maya: noted. i'll update this thread once shadow run + new rollout policy are live.
